title: Capturing the Usaunny
text: “More than anything, Motoyasu-kun, you clam right up the moment Ren and Itsuki's whole mess comes up.”
“I never lie, des-pyon.”
“Well, keeping quiet about the truth is its own kind of problem, though...”
“I never lie, des-pyon.”
“Hmm... true, you're not lying, but still...”
I had to remain a man of integrity, pyon. That was the promise I'd made with Filo-tan, pyon.
“And Itsuki's tail healing up?”
“I healed it, des-pyon. When I turned him back, all that was left was a bruise near his tailbone, so I healed that and transformed him again, and the tail came right back, des-pyon.”
“I see... well, it looked painful, so that's good.”
“Kou was so worried about it, so I fixed it up, pyon.”
“That makes it sound like you wouldn't have bothered if Kou hadn't cared.”
Sure, it looked painful, but honestly it was mostly Itsuki's own fault to begin with, and it wasn't as if it was some part he desperately needed, so leaving it alone would've been fine too, pyon.
“Fufufu... What do you think, Father! Of this form of mine!”
Ren, Itsuki, Rabbit Guy—none of them held a candle to it, des-pyon! Just as I was saying so, the door to the house burst open with a bang, and Ren and Itsuki came storming in, I say.
“I knew you'd be here!”
“That's exactly what I thought! Given the kind of person you are, letting you run loose for a while was the best strategy!”
Ren and Itsuki lunged at me right then, I say.
“What!?”
That Ren and Itsuki had managed to pin down my location was a surprise, to say the least, indeed!
“Ngh... Excuse me, Father, pyon! Tactical retreat, pyon!”
I phased through the wall and fled outside the building, I say.
“Ah, wait!”
“Nobody stops just because they're told to wait, pyon! The only ‘wait’ I'll ever obey is Father's or Filo-tan's, pyoooon!”
“Don't let it get away! We're taking down this rabbit!”
“Right! No matter what, we're catching it, nailing it up, torturing it, and making it confess everything!”
I bolted at full speed, I say! Ren and Itsuki had cleverly figured out where I was hiding, after all!
“Vof... something's making a racket. What's going on? Vof!?”
That's when Wolf, hearing the commotion, showed himself, I say.
“You're Wolf, right! Please catch that thing! It's the usaunny that Ren and I absolutely must catch no matter what! No, I mean, it's Motoyasu-san!”
“V-Vofu!?”

Swept up by Itsuki's command, Wolf spread his arms wide and braced himself, I say. I figured I could probably still slip past Wolf even with the Seven Star Hero's claws in his possession, but getting caught by some unexpected attack would be a hassle. So I decided to handle it, I say.
“Don't you dare underestimate this usaunny, des-pyon! Take this! Four Fairy Morph!”
If you're a Hero too, this spell should work on you just fine, pyon! I'll shrink that big body of yours right down! Bzzzt! I cast Fairy Morph on Wolf, I say.
“Vofuufuu!?”

With a poof, the moment Wolf took my spell, smoke filled the surrounding area, I say. That was exactly what I'd been aiming for. While the smoke threw off Itsuki's aim, I dashed right past Wolf's side, pyon!
“Vo, Vope!”

When I glanced back, tilting my head, there was Wolf, now turned into a peckul, I say. So it turned out casting Fairy Morph on Wolf turned him into a peckul. A wolf man turning into a penguin—now that was hilarious, pyon!
“Ah, now Wolf's a victim of Motoyasu-kun's trouble-making too...”
I heard Father's lamenting voice. Maybe I should just portal out of here! I thought, raising my spear to cast Portal Spear, when—
“I won't let you! Earth Floor!”

Itsuki, lagging a little behind Ren, tried to disrupt my teleport with a spell that amplified the surrounding earth's power. In that case, I could deploy Flame Floor—no, actually, just dashing straight through the area would do just fine.
“Tremble before the speed of my legs, des-pyon!”

Don't you dare underestimate an usaunny's leg speed! I'd already powered up my usaunny form in the Cal Mira dungeon, pyon! Double jumps and all sorts of other abilities were mine to use. There was plenty I could do that beat some clumsy human form, pyon!
“Naofumi-san. Please say exactly the words I tell you! It's, ‘Motoyasu-kun. Wait!’”
“Huh? Oh, right. Motoyasu-kun. Wait!”
“Yes, I say!”
Since it was Father's command, I froze in my tracks instantly, I say.
“Gotcha!”
Bonk! I took Ren's blow right to the head and went down on the spot, I say. Ren and Itsuki wasted no time restraining me and nailing me up onto a practice scarecrow.
“Vofuppen.”
Wolf, now a peckul, was behind Itsuki and Ren, near Father, cooing at his own reflection in a mirror, I say.
“Naofumi-sama, how do I look? Vof—no, pen? Am I cute, vof?”
“Wolf, you're taking this pretty calmly.”
“In this form, Naofumi-sama, would you sleep beside me?”
“Hmm... Someone in Siltvelt described you as more of the cunning, calculating type, but now I feel like I get it.”

While I hung there nailed up, that Wolf character was getting scooped up into Father's arms. That's my position! I thought, but at the same time, getting to witness the strange sight of Father—who himself could turn into a peckul—cradling an actual peckul wasn't bad either. So Fairy Morph worked on Seven Star Heroes too, huh. I vaguely recalled having tested this before, but all I could remember was that it worked, poof, just like that.
“Don't look away!”
“Keep your eyes on us properly!”
My attention kept wanting to drift toward Father and the others, but right now I had to deal with Itsuki and his crew, I say.
“Ngh... des-pyon. For someone in your position, Itsuki, you're being awfully clever.”
“Is that all you have to say!”
“I could say plenty more, I say.”
“Still running your mouth! What is it you're even trying to do!”
“If you'd just kept quiet, we would've overlooked plenty! Why on earth would you pull something so provocative!”
“Because it ticked me off, thinking it would believe it had won some great victory over me, I say.”
“Who's ‘it’!”
Ren and Itsuki were saying this now, of all times, I say. It should've been obvious in an instant who I meant, without even needing to say it!
“Rival, I say!”
“Gaelion? You always made fun of it! There's no way you'd be afraid of it now!”

“Ah... I haven't explained this to you two yet, but Gaelion—well, the original owner of that body has returned. Yesterday, you fought off Luna-chan together with Ren, right? It's not the parent anymore. It's the daughter, the one caught in the loop.”
“What!? Now that you mention it, her movements had gotten sharper, and her spellcasting more skilled... So you're saying you spilled the beans before she could out you first!?”
“I don't know if that's what did it exactly. But it bugs me to think it might be holding some weakness of mine over me, I say!”
Ren kept grilling me, but Itsuki stepped forward as if to cut him off, I say.
“So, Motoyasu-san. Just why did you turn us into this shape!? Before we kill you, we should at least hear the reason, shouldn't we.”
“The reason? I already told you at the start, pyon. I gave you, Itsuki, a firsthand lesson in this country's truth, des-pyon.”

Right after that, Itsuki fired an arrow at me, I say. It sank in with a little thud, but it wasn't enough to pierce through my fur! I caught it with my fur. Itsuki seemed to be under the mistaken impression that it had struck home!
“How can you say something like that so shamelessly! Do you have any idea how much of a hell I went through!”

“I wouldn't know about that, I say. I never imagined you'd get sold out by your own companions right off the bat and tortured, either. All I figured was that in that form, you might come to understand just how harshly Melromarc's people treat someone like Father, pyon.”
“His sentence endings keep flip-flopping all over the place... I guess that means Motoyasu-kun isn't calm either, huh. Or, no—is he actually calm enough to be mocking us...?”
“At most, I figured you'd get to operate with your companions sheltering you, like Ren did, pyon! The fact that you ended up in that state just means you picked your allies poorly, pyon!”
The moment I declared that, an arrow came flying straight for my forehead, so I swiftly dodged it with just a tilt of my neck, I say.
